text: Freya - 30th bday 14 May. into pottery atm, wants a wheel eventually. maybe class voucher?

remind me to ask Hannah how her mum's scan went

B loves gardening, esp old roses - Ebony thinking a David Austin climber + nice gloves. NO more candles apparently, she's got loads. Ebony's brother Kieran driving her there pretending it's just family. need to send Ebony the £20 by Weds

dinner @ Eamon's fri. he's doing lamb. Kalani coming too

Demi + Rohan engagement drinks next Sat @ the Crown

pick up dry cleaning, birthday card for mum, return parcel @ PO before 5

Florin - sinus infection, 2nd round of antibiotics. still rough
Suzanne's 50th - garden party 15 July, 2pm. dress code 'summer whites' ugh. she's into gin, esp pink. need to RSVP by Fri

Salma's little one turns 4 on the 28th. dinosaur mad, esp T rex. party @ soft play 1st of Oct
Sophie + Jakub hosting dinner tomorrow - I'm bringing dessert
Jakub - starts physio for shoulder next Mon, 6 sessions
Kemal invited me to his leaving do thurs - moving to Leeds end of month
Henrik bday 2/11. likes vinyl - jazz mostly, Blue Note stuff. ask Thomas what he's already got
Thomas - migraines again, GP referred him to neuro. appt 19/09. worried tbh

Dawit's daughter Liya has glandular fever - off school 3 wks already, missing all her mocks. school being ok about it, she'll sit them in Jan. Dawit + his wife taking turns working from home, his boss not thrilled. Liya v low, mostly sleeping + bored stiff. she's into K-dramas + crochet. check in w/ him next wk, maybe drop off some yarn for her
Fang - wedding anniv 10 yrs Sat. Wei planning surprise trip to Lisbon, don't say anything

must get gift for Freya by Thurs - pottery voucher from that place in Hove

Rohan's 40th - big party @ his brother Arjun's place, sat 18 Nov, from 8. theme 80s so need an outfit - shoulder pads?? Demi says he's been going on about a decent coffee grinder, the Niche one, mates are chipping in, she's collecting. also he's training for Brighton half in April, maybe running stuff for xmas. RSVP to Arjun by the 1st
invited to Hannah + Eamon's christening for baby Orla, Sun 4th of June, 11am. Hannah's mum flying in from Cork

Barbara's dinner went well - she cried at the cards. Ebony sending pics
Kalani - into sourdough, keeps starter called Doug lol. bday next month, banneton basket?
Chidi - dad's op went ok. home in a few days, Chidi + his sister sorting rails/ramp. pop round w/ food this wknd
Yara feeling better, kid back at nursery Mon
remind me Sat - Tamar's mum's 70th on Sunday. card + flowers from both of us

Sadia - funeral was lovely apparently. she's struggling tho, can't sleep. text her tonight + maybe coffee next wk
own plans: dentist Tues 9:30, haircut Weds, gym 3x this wk
Florin + Anika - housewarming was great. his dad Gheorghe built the shelves. they want help painting spare room in a fortnight

Shreya - Diwali dinner went fine in the end! mother-in-law loved the dal. relieved
Kemal's mum Mrs Yilmaz - diabetic, careful w/ sweets at his do

Jakub says yes go for it, he's getting her a race entry for the Edinburgh 10k. also she's off dairy atm so no cake from the bakery, check the vegan place

Dawit's 50th dinner tomorrow 8pm @ Habesha - don't forget cash for the bill
Fang bday plans - Wei booking karaoke for 3rd March, Fang LOVES karaoke. Kindle + a book voucher from me

Thomas's partner Ben planning a small dinner for him next Fri to celebrate + also Ben's promotion came through on Mon. I'm invited, 7pm @ theirs. Ben says Thomas has been eyeing a Le Creuset casserole dish
text Fiona re her daughter's audition tomorrow - good luck! she's v nervous

Kieran - wife Jo's back better. bbq rearranged 17 June, I'm doing burgers

Ebony bday 6/04. wants a nice fountain pen - mentioned Lamy

Kalani's sister Leilani coming over from Hawaii for it, first time in 3 yrs. I said I'd help him set up at 6. get both a card + bottle of orange wine for Salma, banneton for Kalani

Fang staying here w/ the kids, Mei + Tao, and she's got a big work deadline Thurs. message Wei Mon to see how his mum is + offer Fang help w/ school runs Tues/Thurs. maybe have the kids over this wknd
need to book table for my bday dinner 30/07, 6 people
